name: Curved Navbar
title: Curved Navbar
description: A curved, responsive navbar that smoothly expands into a three-column navigation panel on hover or click.
summary: Inverted outer curves connect the compact navigation bar to the page. A reversible GSAP timeline synchronizes width, panel height, and staggered content. Customize brand, links, featured content, colors, curve radius, timing, and spring response. On narrow screens the navbar expands to fill its page container, with aligned top controls and a scrollable panel.
highlights: Inverted outer curves and aligned rounded lower corners
Interruptible expansion and reversal with synchronized content
Container-based compact navigation and stacked mobile panel
Mouse, click, keyboard, outside press and Escape interactions
Customizable links, branding, featured content, colors and motion
Reduced-motion fallback and scoped animation cleanup
Clean desktop bar without a dropdown icon; keyboard disclosure remains available
Full screen mobile disclosure with a fixed header and scrollable content
anatomy: Container-query wrapper and floating navigation shell
Brand, inline links, primary action and disclosure trigger
Expandable panel with introduction, links and custom featured content

physics.description: A single reversible timeline animates width and panel height alongside staggered transforms and opacity. Stiffness controls a subtle back easing overshoot. Resize observation recalculates the container geometry. All timelines, delayed calls, observers and document listeners are cleaned up.

keyboard.description: Move through brand, links, action, disclosure and open panel links.
Close the panel and return focus to the disclosure trigger.

accessibility.aria: Labeled navigation with aria-expanded and aria-controls on the trigger. The closed panel is inert and hidden from assistive technology. Focus leaving the navbar closes the disclosure. Narrow containers use click or keyboard activation instead of hover.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Expansion and stagger animations resolve immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

recommended: Landing pages with image or color backgrounds
Compact desktop navigation with an expanded discovery panel
Use the custom children slot for featured content
bestPractices: Place inside a full-width page header with sufficient space below for the floating panel
Use real destinations and short navigation labels
Match the page top strip to the navbar background to connect the inverted curves
Use a contrasting foreground and accent color
Keep featured content and link descriptions concise

props.defaultValue: Explore the details. Find your next perspective.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom featured content in the final panel column.

props.name: duration
props.description: Expansion duration in seconds, bounded to 0.15–1.5.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring response from 0 to 1. Higher values increase the restrained width overshoot.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Pointer leave grace period in seconds, bounded to 0–0.6.

props.name: compactWidth
props.description: Maximum collapsed width in pixels; adapts to the container.

props.name: expandedWidth
props.description: Maximum expanded width in pixels; never smaller than the collapsed width.

props.name: curveRadius
props.description: Radius of the lower corners and inverted outer curves, bounded to 12–40.

props.name: background
props.description: Navbar and outer curve color.

props.name: foreground

props.name: openOnHover
